events.name: THE DRAGON BALL HUNT: DENDE'S NEWS

steps.text: Cooler has stolen all seven Dragon Balls and hidden them all around the world!
In the wrong hands their power could doom the Earth.
Please find all seven and bring them back here to me. You can fly - search everywhere!

events.name: THE DRAGON BALL HUNT: BACK TO DENDE

steps.text: Keep looking, %s! The count is in the top right corner. Cooler hid them all over the world.
You've found all the Dragon Balls!
Thank you, %s. The Earth is safe again!
